dispositions.currentValue: Cause a planned change or outcome to become a reality.
dispositions.proposedValue: Cause a change or outcome to happen.
dispositions.rationale: Removes unsupported "planned" restriction. Authoritative lexicography (MLA, Cambridge, Oxford) confirms bringing about a change does not entail intentional planning or prior design. Transitive valency and formal register are preserved without altering candidate identity or creating new senses.
dispositions.dependenciesGraphImpact: No identity or graph change proposed. Example ("designed to effect sweeping changes") and transitive grammar remain compatible.
dispositions.openQuestions: Human Lead Editorial Reviewer to approve final wording upon canonical draft persistence.

dispositions.currentValue: Influence the condition or course of someone or something.
dispositions.proposedValue: Have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.
dispositions.rationale: Broadens definition to avoid making "condition or course" an exhaustive or overly restrictive limitation. Fits people, situations, and outcomes in the scoped influence sense without implying exhaustive coverage of all affect meanings.
dispositions.dependenciesGraphImpact: No graph impact. Preserves transitive valency.
dispositions.openQuestions: LER to decide exact learner wording and future omitted-sense coverage.

dispositions.currentValue: An outcome attributable to an action or circumstance.
dispositions.proposedValue: A change or result caused by an event, action, or other cause.
dispositions.rationale: Broadens result definition beyond strict explicit attribution while keeping noun result core distinct from verb effect.
dispositions.openQuestions: Human editor to decide whether other effect noun uses are separate future coverage.

dispositions.currentValue: Connected with how an economy operates.
dispositions.proposedValue: Connected with an economy, trade, industry, or money.
dispositions.rationale: Expands scope to include trade, industry, and money as supported by lexicographic evidence, avoiding the narrower "how an economy operates".
dispositions.dependenciesGraphImpact: No graph impact. Profitability sense remains excluded from this record.
dispositions.openQuestions: LER to review sense boundary and whether profitability use merits a separate record.

dispositions.currentValue: Using relatively little of a resource for a purpose.
dispositions.proposedValue: Using money, time, fuel, or other resources carefully and without waste.
dispositions.rationale: Clarifies resource-use scope without restricting to abstract physical consumption; clearly distinguishes economical from economic.
dispositions.openQuestions: Decide whether monetary/cost use belongs in this sense or future coverage.
